name: Kanban column
summary: One board column with its count and add button, holding task cards with labels, due date, assignee, comments and subtask progress; one card is lifted mid-drag.
a11y: Cards are focusable list items with a described keyboard-move hint; progress bars are role=progressbar with values, and counts have screen-reader words.

use_when: any pipeline of items moving through a few named stages, such as hiring or support tickets
avoid_when: many items compared by several fields at once: use receipts-table
a single task's steps in order: use setup-steps or agent-steps
a timeline of events: use activity-feed

parts.name: status
parts.what: a coloured dot for the column's stage

parts.name: title
parts.what: the column's name, followed by the card count

parts.name: count
parts.what: how many cards are in the column

parts.name: header_actions
parts.what: add a card and column options

parts.name: cards
parts.what: one task card; one can be lifted as if being dragged

parts.name: labels
parts.what: one label with a coloured dot

parts.name: progress
parts.what: a bar and a count of subtasks done

parts.name: due
parts.what: the due date; red when overdue

parts.name: comments
parts.what: how many comments the card has

parts.name: assignee
parts.what: the photo of the person it is assigned to

parts.name: add
parts.what: adds a card at the bottom of the column

empty.how: with no cards, show the header with a count of 0 and a dashed box above Add card saying 'Drop a card here'

loading.how: keep the header and show two cards with grey bars in place of the title and footer

error.how: if a move fails, put the card back where it was and show toast-stack with the reason

disabled.how: for a column the person cannot change, hide Add card and the add button and set the cards to cursor default

overflow.how: a long column grows the page; give the card list a max height and overflow-y: auto so it scrolls in its own box

long_text.how: card titles wrap inside the card; labels and footer items stay on one line each and wrap as a group

keyboard: Tab moves through the add and options buttons, then each card, then Add card
Enter or Space presses the focused button; a focused card has no action of its own
